# bisibility for DeepSeek Harness

> Part of bisibility - an open-source SEO
> platform for keyword research, backlink analysis, and Go

ogle rank tracking. This repository
> contains the DeepSeek Harness plugin.
**Ask your agent where you rank. No tabs, no exports, just answers.**

A sidebar panel signs you in to bisibility once with OAuth, and the DeepSeek Harness agent gets
the

bisibility MCP tools: rank tracking, keyword research, backlinks, and AI visibility. No API
key to p
aste, no token in a config file.

## Updates and rollback

DeepSeek Harness has no in-place upgrade for plugins outside its own catalog. When a newer
version e

xists, the bisibility panel shows "bisibility X.Y.Z is available", and the bisibility
card in Discov

er shows **Update available** (with a market source added). That label is a
status, not a button. To

**Update available** (with a market source added). That label is a
status, not a button. To update:

1. Open **Plugins**, select **bisibility**, and select **Uninstall**.
2. Install the new version: in

**Discover** the bisibility card offers **Install** again, or
use Add plugin with the new tag.
3. Q
uit and reopen DeepSeek Harness.

Your sign-in survives the reinstall: the OAuth records live in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`,
not in th

e plugin. To roll back, install an older version from the card's **Versions** list
or its tag. The p

anel reads the market index at most every six hours; release notes say what
each update needs.
## Troubleshooting

- **No bisibility icon in the sidebar.** Quit and reopen DeepSeek Harness.
- **Startup reports `@bis

ibility/dsh-plugin: import failed`.** Another copy of the
plugin is installed, for example an older

local install under a different name.
Remove every bisibility entry on the Plugins page, install it

again from the market,
then quit and reopen the app.
- **The panel asks you to connect again.** Sele

ct Connect account. If the browser
lands on the bisibility dashboard instead of returning to the har

ness, you are
signed in; select Connect account once more to finish.
- **Installation is refused for

an incompatible version.** The plugin declares the
DeepSeek Harness versions it supports. Update De

epSeek Harness, or pick a version
the market marks as compatible.
## How it works

The hosted Bisibility MCP resource (`https://bisibility.com/api/mcp`) is an OAuth
2.1 protected reso

urce, while the shipped MCP client
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) only accepts a static `Authorizat

ion` header.
This bundle closes that gap without forking the client:
| Piece | Role |
| `index.js` (Host) | OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with dynamic client registration and PKCE S2

56, token storage, loopback MCP proxy, MCP client mount |
| `client.js` (browser) | Left-sidebar ent
ry (`sidebar.panellist`, id `bisibility`), the `main` panel, and the New Bisibility conversation act

ion |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Declares the panel row and the `bisibility` agent preset; the MCP clien
t row is created at runtime |

1. The panel calls `POST /bisibility/oauth/open`, which registers a public OAuth
client on first use

, builds the PKCE challenge, and opens the authorization
URL in the default browser. `GET /bisibilit

y/oauth/start` returns the same URL
without launching anything.
2. `GET /bisibility/oauth/callback`

validates `state`, exchanges the code, and
stores the refresh token in the harness credential store

(`BISIBILITY_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN`), never in a patch file or the environment.
A pending sign-in stay

s valid for 15 minutes, across a Host reload.
3. With a token available, the Host mounts `@deepseek-

ai/dsh-mcp-client` against
the loopback proxy, so the client never starts against an unauthenticated

endpoint.
4. `POST /bisibility/mcp` forwards to the resource with a fresh Bearer token,
refreshing

it 60 seconds before expiry. Requests carrying a browser `Origin`
or `Sec-Fetch-Site` header are ref

used, so a web page cannot drive paid tools
through the proxy. The other OAuth routes, except the ca

llback, require the
DeepSeek Harness session and answer 401 without it.
5. Each forwarded request ca

rries `X-Bisibility-Client:
bisibility-dsh-plugin/<version>`. When Bisibility answers `426` because

the
installed version is below its minimum, the panel shows Update required with
that minimum and a
button to the Plugins page.

If you sign in from a signed-out browser, Bisibility may land on its dashboard
[该节后续省略]
### Compatibility contract

Role ids (`bisibility`, `preset-bisibility`) and route paths
(`/bisibility/oauth/*`, `/bisibility/mc

p`) are stable. Overrides in your profile
`cordis.patch.yml` address rows by id, so a change to eith
er is a breaking release.
## Development

- Install a checkout into a development profile as a `link:` dependency, for example
through the Plu

gins page with the absolute path of the checkout.
- `client.js`, copy, styles, and locale load in th

e browser half: reload the page.
